without-level-60-magic.player: Hello there. What is this place?

without-level-60-magic.npc: Do not waste my time with trivial questions. I am the Great Kolodion, master of battle magic. I have an arena to run.
Hah! A wizard of your level? Don't be absurd.

after-mage-arena-i.npc: Hey there, how are you? Are you enjoying the bloodshed?

options.text: I think I've had enough for now.

steps.player: I think I've had enough for now.

steps.npc: A shame. You're a good battle mage. I hope to see you soon.

options.text: How can I use my new spells outside of the arena?

steps.player: How can I use my new spells outside of the arena?

steps.npc: Experience, my friend, experience. Once you've used the spell enough times in the arena, you'll be able to use them in the rest of Gielinor.
Not so good for the citizens; they won't stand a chance.

steps.player: How am I doing so far?

I've made a note of the spells you still need to learn in your journal.
You have indeed shown potential, [player name].
However, a wizard of your level wouldn't stand a chance.

steps.npc: I am one of the most powerful mages in existence. But even my power has limitations. There are some beings however that have power exceeding even my own.
